transcript: Welcome to the great theater Adventure Day 31, The last day of my month long Marathon to see as much theater as possible. Spent most of the day in the Drama Book Shop getting some work done and trying not to buy every single play that I'd seen on this trip before grabbing some empanada mama and heading to the final show of the trip, table 17. Table 17 is a new play currently playing at MCC, and I had previously seen a reading of this play and fell in love with it. I was so excited to see it fully staged, and it did not disappoint. Between chicken and biscuits, table 17, and Pure Glitter, his play that I saw a reading of last month, Douglas Lines, is quickly becoming one of my favorite contemporary playwrights. I just love his work. It's so funny. And getting to see this fully staged was the perfect way to finish off my month long Marathon, and then it was time to grab my stuff and head to the airport. Whenever I'm flying west, I always like to take the first flight in the morning, and then that way I can just stay out with friends, go to the airport, stay up all night and sleep on the plane, and then when I wake up, I'm home. Thank you so much for following along this journey. It has been a wild ride seeing so much theater, because theater truly is life. I'm definitely Happy to be home for now, but I cannot wait for my next theater adventure.
